name: ASM-002 wheel bogie / suspension carrier assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact road-wheel bogie module, smaller and faster than the BRIEF-001 tracked vehicle integration stress test.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact mechanical wheel bogie / suspension carrier assembly for a tracked robot or small rover. The assembly should include a base rail/carrier frame, mirrored left and right side brackets, repeated road wheels, axle rods, spacer or bushing components, mounting bosses or holes integrated into the frame/brackets, and an optional simple spring/shock cylinder. Keep the geometry robust, simple, and fast to generate.
assumptions: This is an intermediate assembly benchmark intended to exercise semantic hierarchy and repeated components without the BRIEF-001 full-vehicle complexity.
Robust simple boxes, cylinders, and compounds are preferred over fragile booleans or detailed decorative hardware.
Generated STEP, GLB, and topology artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not source of truth.
